#!/bin/bash
# Auto-deploy OpenVLA goal and long baselines once downloads complete
set -e

PROJ=/root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress
GOAL_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-goal
LONG_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-10
EXPECTED_SHARDS=4

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

check_complete() {
    local dir=$1
    local count=$(ls "$dir"/model-*-of-*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    if [ "$count" -eq "$EXPECTED_SHARDS" ]; then
        local min_size=$(du -b "$dir"/model-*-of-*.safetensors | awk '{print $1}' | sort -n | head -1)
        if [ "$min_size" -gt 1000000000 ]; then
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    return 1
}

LONG_DEPLOYED=0

        cd $PROJ

        nohup python -u eval_openvla_l2norm_libero.py \
            --mode baseline \
            --model_path $GOAL_DIR \
            --unnorm_key libero_goal \
            --suite libero_goal \
            --seed 42 \
            --output eval_results/openvla_baseline_goal_seed42.json \

        echo "[$(date)] Long checkpoint complete. Deploying eval..."
        cd $PROJ
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache MUJOCO_GL=egl \
        nohup python -u eval_openvla_l2norm_libero.py \
            --mode baseline \
            --model_path $LONG_DIR \
            --unnorm_key libero_10 \
            --suite libero_10 \
            --seed 42 \
            --output eval_results/openvla_baseline_long_seed42.json \
            > eval_results/openvla_baseline_long_seed42.log 2>&1 &
        echo "[$(date)] Long eval started: PID=$!"
        LONG_DEPLOYED=1
    fi

    if [ "$GOAL_DEPLOYED" -eq 0 ]; then
        goal_size=$(du -sh "$GOAL_DIR" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
        echo "[$(date)] Goal download: $goal_size"
    fi
    if [ "$LONG_DEPLOYED" -eq 0 ]; then
        long_size=$(du -sh "$LONG_DIR" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
        echo "[$(date)] Long download: $long_size"
    fi
done
